limits: Single-host functional acceptance with one timing sample, not a production latency guarantee or a Node comparison.
The scale suite uses 1000 logical worker identities over supervisor connections, not 1000 Linux sandboxes or live model agents.
Native execution and claim installation are substituted in the scale fixture; real native enforcement is exercised separately by the 26-test suite.
Hosted claim-service throughput, multi-host delivery and claim-availability subscriptions remain untested or unimplemented.
GitHub Actions could not start due account billing/spending restrictions; local and AWS checks were run directly.
